notes.title: Version - 1.1.0
notes.content:
* Added combo system explanation to the tutorial.
* Fixed a bug where deleting save data could cause the game to become unresponsive.
* Addressed several issues affecting sound effects playback.
* Updated parts of the story with revised content.
* Changed the value of number 6 in the first run path to 8.
* Added option to skip animations.
* Ensured that characters no longer receive duplicate abilities.
* Objects, combos, and blessings are now available from the beginning.
* Reduced shortened overall game length.

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 - Hotfix
notes.content: * Fixed a bug that caused the game's FPS to drop drastically after a while of playing, due to the game's audio management.
